name: batch-chaos
checklist_item: F. Chaos / map effects + G. Classes / CF_PACK_ORIGINALS / Chaos Mage
description: The fifth class. Entropy (PERFECT-gated status), Backlash (CRIT_FAIL-gated self-status) and Wild Magic Surge -- the 15% hazard TILE, which state-v2's new combat.tiles[].auraStatuses makes assertable for the first time.

seed_search.found_note: the seed on which Wild Magic Surge's 15% roll lands a hazard

notes: Five classes need two batches. This is the second, and it is deliberately NOT four classes deep: the hazard tile is read by scanning every tile's auraStatuses, so a board crowded with other classes' tile effects would make the assert ambiguous.

Wild Magic Surge: Trigger ON_TURN_START, ProcChance 15 / AiProcChance 15, Budget ONCE_PER_ROUND, no conditions, Target: RANDOM_TILE, Duration 5, StatusOneOf [STATUS_FIRE_00, STATUS_WATER_00, STATUS_SHOCK_00, STATUS_ACID_00]. 15% is exactly the kind of gate that must be seed-searched once and pinned, never waited for.

RANDOM_TILE means no coordinate is knowable in advance, which is why the assert uses tile: "any". The screenshot tell is what pins the decal to a specific tile -- state says a hazard exists, only the picture says the player can see it.

This assert was IMPOSSIBLE before state-v2 carried combat.tiles[]. VenueTileComponent.AuraStatuses was unreadable, so a tile feature was screenshot-only. Note the null rule: the game leaves AuraStatuses null until the first aura lands, so a null VALUE is a clean tile ([]) while an absent MEMBER is null plus member_missing -- bench.py reports the second as UNREADABLE, never as a clean board.

Entropy needs ROLL_TIER EQ PERFECT and Backlash needs ROLL_TIER EQ CRIT_FAIL. Both are recorded as steps so the pinned seed can be searched against either; on a seed that produces neither they read NO-FIRE, which is honest, not a failure.

fixture.notes:
STATUS 2026-08-26: NOT BUILT, DEFERRED BY THE OPERATOR. The bed is still genuinely required -- a live inventory of every pristine fixture (each one LOADED and read with crucible_party_list, since a .ftk2 is opaque on disk and fixture_health only checks SIZE) found NO Chaos Mage anywhere:
  batch-4class.ftk2  Vampiric / Pacifist / Pokemon Trainer / Gary   -- real display names, GOOD BED
  c750d05b-....ftk2  Vampiric / Pacifist / Pokemon Trainer / Gary   -- a duplicate of the above
  bdb1596d-....ftk2  CF_ORIG_* + CF_EOR_RUNEMAGE but named Thief / Shepherd / Corsair /
                     Bladedancer -- built with set_class, so USELESS for any identity screenshot
  gary-captured-bat.ftk2  same vanilla-named party; carries a captured bat but not a usable
                     identity tell. NOTE it shares run id 63d7d316 with batch-4class.ftk2, so
                     copying it in overwrites the good bed's slot.
  DIRTY-2026-08-26-gary-midcombat.ftk2  known corrupt, never load.
So Chaos Mage cannot be exercised at all until this bed exists.

make-fixture.ps1 got three real bugs fixed on the way to this conclusion, and it now reaches the party screen and sets slots reliably; the next attempt should start from a clean boot and just run:
  .\make-fixture.ps1 -PartyClassIds CF_ORIG_CHAOSMAGE,CF_ORIG_VAMPIRIC,CF_ORIG_GARY,CF_ORIG_TRAINER -FixtureName batch-chaos
  (1) the first-death advisory modal on PromptUIDocument blocks the party screen and ate the add-character press -- now dismissed by exact name `ok-btn`.
  (2) focus('add-character-btn') + key(enter) added TWO characters per press, which also left the class stepper bound to the wrong slot -- now a single crucible_ui_click_nth on index 0.
  (3) Get-ClassSelectorTexts did `return @(...)`, and PowerShell UNROLLS a one-element array on return, so with one slot filled it handed back a bare string and `[0]` indexed a CHARACTER: the loop reported "never reached 'CF_ORIG_CHAOSMAGE' after 150 steps; last seen 'C'" while the slot was already correct. Fixed with `return ,$texts`. MaxClassCycles also went 40 -> 150.

ORIGINAL RECIPE: New campaign -> CHARACTER CREATION for every slot. NEVER crucible_party_set_class: it rewrites ConfigName but not the display name, so the class is right in state and every screenshot shows a stale vanilla name -- that is exactly what makes bdb1596d and gary-captured-bat unusable above. Save, copy the .ftk2 out of GameRuns\ into %USERPROFILE%\Backups tk2-fixtures under this name, then set status to 'built'.

setup.why: godmode ON tops HP up every tick and masks every HP effect.

steps.label: CHAOS MAGE casts Dark Bolt -- Entropy on a PERFECT roll

tells.expect: the party HUD card reads "Chaos Mage" -- our class, not a vanilla one

the target's HP bar drops; on a PERFECT roll one of Poison / Fire / Shock / Water / Bleed / Acid / Ice / Confuse is also on its portrait (Entropy). The ability bar reads the VANILLA name "Dark Bolt" -- that is deliberate, not a missing string

steps.label: advance a full round so ON_TURN_START rolls the 15% surge
WILD MAGIC SURGE -- a hazard tile appears on the board

asserts.why: Wild Magic Surge draws ONE of these four per proc (StatusOneOf), so naming a single id would fail three good surges out of four. The claim is that a hazard landed, not which element it was. The report prints which id actually landed on which tile.

tells.expect: the party HUD card reads "Chaos Mage" -- our class, not a vanilla one
a hazard DECAL on one specific tile of the grid. State saying auraStatuses is non-empty while no decal is drawn is the invisible-mechanic FAIL -- this is precisely the case the paired rule exists for
the party HUD card reads "Chaos Mage" -- our class, not a vanilla one
the hazard decal is still on its tile and the grid is intact
